Subject: Request: pen test required for SIG / CAIQ upload

Hi Karthik,

Following our procurement review, GC Health needs a copy of Redwood's most recent penetration test report (redacted as necessary) plus an evidence inventory that maps pen test findings to the SIG/CAIQ control rows. This is a gating artifact for our security/compliance review and the marketplace onboarding.

What we need from you:
- A redacted pen test PDF we can include in our GRC portal (PII removed)
- An evidence inventory CSV that lists artifacts and associated control IDs
- Confirmation you will upload to our GRC portal (link below) or send a secure transfer

Can you confirm timeline? Procurement is aiming to complete the security review by Jan 26.

Link they provided: https://grc.gchealth.com/upload/records/GC-12345

Thanks,
Alice

GC Health

Mina / Marissa — forwarding request from GC Health. Timeline: they want everything in by Jan 26 for marketplace onboarding. Key asks: redacted PT report and an evidence inventory mapping findings to SIG/CAIQ controls.

Quick context: this is a mid-market deal, HubSpot deal id GCH-2027-01-54321. Procurement is sensitive to attachments in third-party portals; prefer we upload directly to their GRC portal but will accept an SFTP or secure DocuSign envelope.

Can you confirm:
- Redaction scope (sensitive hostnames, IPs, tester IDs)?
- Estimate to produce redacted PDF + evidence CSV and a short cover memo?

Thanks — Karthik

Date: Fri, 15 Jan 2027 11:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: pen test required for SIG / CAIQ upload

Hi all,

Thanks for the ping. Suggest the following redaction policy for customer-facing artifacts: 
- Remove specific external IPs and internal hostnames; replace with environment tags (e.g., \"prod-app-123\" → \"prod-app-REDACTED\").
- Remove tester personal identifiers and internal Slack/issue tracker URLs.
- Keep vulnerability severity, CVE references, and remediation status.

Work plan and ETA: 
- I will produce a redacted PDF (v1) by Mon Jan 18 EOD PT.
- Marissa will assemble an evidence_inventory CSV mapping findings -> SIG control IDs (rows: finding id, control id, artifact filename, remediation status) by Tue Jan 19 noon PT.
- Laura will draft a one-page cover memo stating scope, test date, and redaction summary by Tue Jan 19 EOD PT.

Notes on scope: The original pen test covers external network and web app testing performed Dec 2026; excludes SOC2 internal process testing. We should call that out on the cover memo so GC Health can map coverage to their SIG rows.

Security caveat: We should avoid uploading raw logs or PII to their portal. If they insist on zipped artifacts with hashes, route through our security S3 bucket with a time-limited signed URL.

I'll also flag any high/critical open items that have no mitigation yet.

-Mina
Senior Security Engineer

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Tan <alice.tan@gchealth.com>
Cc: Victor Ramos <victor.ramos@gchealth.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 08:52:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: GC Health - SIG evidence onboarding and pen test redaction plan

Hi Alice — quick update and proposed next steps. Thanks for the details and the portal link. Our security team has reviewed and we will deliver the artifacts as requested.

Planned deliverables and dates: 
- redwood_pen_test_redacted_v1.pdf (redacted per policy) — uploaded to your portal by Mon Jan 18 EOD PT
- evidence_inventory_20270115.csv — uploaded to your portal by Tue Jan 19 12:00 PM PT
- GCHealth_SIG_Questionnaire.xlsx — filled where pen test artifacts apply and attached as supplemental (we will mark N/A where not in scope) by Tue Jan 19 EOD PT
- Cover memo (scope, test date, redaction summary) — Tue Jan 19 EOD PT

Upload method: We will attempt an upload to the portal URL you provided. If that fails we will share a time-limited signed URL from our secure artifact bucket. We will not include raw logs or any PII.

Please confirm if you require a DocuSign transfer or prefer portal upload. Also let us know if you need redaction of the CVE numbers (we typically leave CVE refs intact).

Attaching: redwood_pen_test_redacted_v1.pdf (stub), evidence_inventory_20270115.csv (stub) — scanning and final redactions still in progress.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jan 2027 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Upload confirmation and remediation note for GC Health

Update for the thread — final post-upload notes: 
- I completed the evidence_inventory_20270115.csv and confirmed mapping against the SIG spreadsheet. File includes columns: finding_id, control_id, artifact, remediated (yes/no), notes.
- redwood_pen_test_redacted_v1.pdf uploaded to https://grc.gchealth.com/upload/records/GC-12345 (upload record ID GC-12345-A).
- Cover memo (GCHealth_cover_memo_20270119.pdf) uploaded and references test window Dec 03–08 2026.

Outstanding remediation items we disclosed to the customer (open, work-in-progress):
- Finding PT-2026-34 (High): webapp input validation — scheduled remediation in Q1 2027, mitigation planned by Feb 12, 2027.
- Finding PT-2026-47 (Medium): outdated library in analytics pipeline — patch rollout in progress, ETA Jan 28, 2027.

I placed hashes (SHA256) for each uploaded file in the evidence_inventory and noted the access method (portal upload).

If GC Health requests a notarized redaction log or an S3 signed URL instead, we can produce that on request.

Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference
